# Summary of task 63: `kinds.generated_markers`

Server version: `0.63.0`.

## What was built

- `kinds.generated_markers` (CONFIG.md#kinds), default `["@generated", "DO NOT EDIT", "Code generated by",
  "auto-generated"]`: from the config file, shown by `get_config` (a new section `[kinds]`) with its source, changed
  and reset by `update_config`, replaced for one request by the new request object `kinds` (a list replaces the
  configured one, `[]` checks no markers).
- A file with one of the markers in its first lines is `kind = generated` and, with `skip_generated`, skipped;
  markers are compared case-sensitively (spec clarified in its own commit, with the errors:
  `invalid value for 'kinds.generated_markers': a list of strings is expected`, in a request
  `'kinds.generated_markers' must be a list of strings`).

## Architecture

- `src/search/kinds.rs`: `KindOptions` (markers, marker lines, the four wildcard lists; the built-in rules by
  default), `KindRules::new`; no file is opened for the markers when there are none.
- `src/search/mod.rs`: `SearchOptions.kinds`.
- `src/config/keys.rs`: `Key::GeneratedMarkers`.
- `src/description.rs`: the `kinds` object in the input schema.

## Deviations from the plan

- The full `get_config` examples of tasks 35–43 show the new section (separate commit).
- E63.8 was fixed in its own commit: its config file has the marker in its first lines, so it is generated too.

## Tests

- examples E63.1–E63.9 (fixture `markers`)
- unit: `search::kinds::tests::other_markers_and_none`, `request::tests::kinds`

## Limitations and known gaps

- The other keys of the section come with tasks 64–68.

## Try it

`{ "query": "kind = generated", "kinds": { "generated_markers": ["AUTOGEN"] } }`
